title: Your box
covers: The box from your project: 6 strands and mask 2_2_1_3 on the Ground, 4 strands and mask 2_4_1_5 on Level 1.
expect: The copy (sets 3, 4) has 4_1 ... 3_3 and mask 4_2_3_3 on the Ground, 4_4 ... 3_5 and mask 4_4_3_5 on Level 1.

title: Whole group on the Ground
covers: A group resting entirely on the Ground while another box sits on Level 1. New strands land on Level 1, so this is where the old code went wrong most.
expect: Every layer of the copy, masks included, is on the Ground.

title: Whole group on the top level
covers: A group entirely on Level 2 (the top level) above a box on the Ground.
expect: Every layer of the copy is on Level 2.

title: Spread over four levels
covers: One box whose strands are spread over the Ground and Levels 1, 2 and 3; the masks sit on the higher level of their two strands.
expect: Each copy is on the same level as its original: 2_1 on Ground, 1_1 on Level 3, 2_2 on Level 1, 1_2 on Level 2, 2_3 on Level 2, 1_3 on Level 1, 2_4 on Level 3, 1_4 on Ground, 2_5 on Level 1, 1_5 on Level 2.

title: Raised masks
covers: Masks raised above their strands on the Masks tab: 2_2_1_3 (strands on the Ground) raised to Level 2, 2_4_1_5 (strands on Level 1) raised to Level 2.
expect: Both copied masks are on Level 2, while their strands keep their own levels (4_2, 3_3 on the Ground; 4_4, 3_5 on Level 1).

title: Mask between two levels
covers: Mask 2_2_1_3 joins 2_2 on the Ground and 1_3 on Level 2, so it sits on Level 2.
expect: The copied mask 4_2_3_3 is on Level 2 (the higher of 4_2 and 3_3); it can be moved up but not below Level 2.

title: Mask whose partner is outside the group
covers: Group "pink only" holds set 1 alone, but masks 2_2_1_3 and 2_4_1_5 also use set 2 (on Level 1). Duplicating pulls the missing set-2 strands into the copy.
expect: Every copied layer, including the pulled-in set-2 copies, is on the level of the layer it copies; the copied masks follow their strands.

title: Project without levels
covers: The box with no levels at all: no Level rows, everything on the Ground.
expect: No level row appears; every copy is on the Ground; the saved file has no levels.

title: Two groups on two levels
covers: Group "ground" (sets 1, 2) on the Ground and group "upstairs" (sets 3, 4) on Level 1. Duplicate both, one after the other.
expect: The copy of "ground" is all on the Ground; the copy of "upstairs" is all on Level 1.

title: Empty levels above
covers: The box uses only the Ground and Level 1, while the project has 3 levels.
expect: The copy keeps the Ground / Level 1 split; nothing goes up to the empty Level 3, and the project still has 3 levels.

title: Hidden and shadow-only layers
covers: 1_2 (Ground) and 2_5 (Level 1) are hidden; 2_3 (Ground) is shadow-only.
expect: Copies keep their levels and stay hidden / shadow-only like their originals.

title: A level block selected while duplicating
covers: The box, with a second box on Level 1 so the Level 1 block has strands to select.
steps: On the Strands tab, click the "Level 1" row name to select its block.
With the block still selected, duplicate group "box".
expect: Copies keep their own levels; the selected Level 1 block does not pull them up.

title: Copy of a copy
covers: The box; duplicate it, then duplicate the copy "box(1)".
expect: Both copies (sets 3, 4 and sets 5, 6) keep the Ground / Level 1 split.

title: One strand on Level 1 in its own group
covers: Set 5: just the start strand of a box, alone, on Level 1, over the box on the Ground.
expect: The copy 7_1 is on Level 1.

title: Overhand knot
covers: The shipped overhand knot design: its one set in a group, on Level 1 (set 1: Level 1).
expect: Every copied set is on the same level as the set it copies; the copied masks follow their strands.
